submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Draw independent NE running phase 12 using input1 as EDIT TARGET; change ONLY pose of hips/knees/ankles/legs and tiny natural head bob. Preserve exact head pixel size, fixed camera and canvas, back three-quarter facing upper-right. LEFT terminal stance: starting from target LEFT weightbearing pose, keep LEFT forefoot at its same fixed ground contact, raise ONLY LEFT heel 18 pixels with ankle plantar flexion. LEFT knee opens slightly and pelvis rises 12 pixels without any resizing. RIGHT swing knee passes forward upper-right, shoe still folded and airborne. NOT both feet flying; one clear toe/forefoot bears weight. Keep BOTH shoe heel-to-toe axes along upper-right travel, no toe-out V-shaped feet, knees track over toes. Preserve correct anatomical RIGHT hand FIVE-card fan on screen right, LEFT hand bronze bell on screen left, shoulder and wrist chain unchanged. Only five cards, no sixth sliver. Keep arms and props almost identical except small natural recoil; NEVER exchange hand props. Keep face/hair/pony crown, waist knot, rich painted red-gold costume and near ground y920 at1024, rootx512. Input2identity,3NEidleorientation,4styleonly. Native square>=1024 RGBA actual transparency. No floor shadow glow particles labels. Single real new frame; no copied pose or bitmap repositioning.
